# storeengine

```go
import "github.com/kitsunium/sdk/framework/internal/app/storeengine"
```

Package storeengine is what framework/app/store plugs into kit: the engines the framework's stores run on — the SDK's document store in memory, in the data directory and over SQL —, the framework's scope on a database — the SDK's transaction manager, its check and its migrator — and the migrations of the framework's tables (ADR 0179 §1). The framework's core imports neither the SDK's docstore nor its sql: it reaches them through plug, and a product that declares no store links none of them.

Package storeengine — the compile-time proof that the engines are the framework's.

<a name="SQLOf"></a>
## func [SQLOf](<https://github.com/kitsunium/sdk/blob/main/framework/internal/app/storeengine/database.go>)

```go
func SQLOf(db plug.Database) (tm sql.Transactor, dialect sql.Dialect, ok bool)
```

SQLOf is the SDK's transaction manager and dialect of db, a database this package opened: what the queues' SQL broker runs on, so that a publication joins the transaction its context carries (ADR 0179 step 4), and what a mailer's spool defers its announcements on (step 6); false for a database it did not open.
